messages:
ana: FYI - ACME partner flagged a reproducible crash on our marketplace image after their upstream ROCm 5.5 kernel module got auto-updated. Happened in their SI lab during long-running inference tests. Need a pin + hotfix/comms plan.

jordan: ugh. do we have a stack trace or kernel oops?

ana: attaching the minimal logs they sent (sanitized):
```
[   45.123456] rocm: fatal: kv_cache alloc failed at step 1024
[   45.123789] llc: exception in kernel module rocm_kv
Segfault at 0x7ff...
```

mike: tagging the marketplace folks. Does this only surface when our marketplace image is signed with their kernel package installed?

marketplace-bot: Automated smoke results for image r2026-03-18: failed on 1 of 12 hw-configs (si-acme-rtx-a100). Failure group: rocm-kernel-module. See /ci/artifacts/2026-03-18/rocm-smoke.log

sarah: short term: we can pin the marketplace image to ROCm 5.4 / driver bundle that passed our QA matrix. Long term: need to coordinate with ACME on kernel ABI stability.

jordan: agree. propose immediate plan: 1) pin marketplace images for affected SKUs to rocm-5.4-driver-2.3.4 (canary today, full roll tomorrow). 2) publish partner advisory + rollback playbook. 3) request ACME reproducer + minimal steps.

ana: timeline? we have a marketing comms freeze until EOD tomorrow for joint announcement — need to avoid surprise.

mike: can ops do a hotfix channel for midnighters? I'll own partner comms. Sarah, can you own the pin & image rebuild?

sarah: on it. rebuilding pinned images now. commands I'm using to verify: 
```bash
# check nvidia driver version
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv,noheader
# check rocm
/opt/rocm/bin/rocminfo | head -n 5
```

jordan: also add these tests to the smoke: 24h long-running single-stream, kv-cache eviction & perf-regression. If it passes, we flip the dedicated SKU.

ana: ACME says the crash only shows when a third-party kernel module (acme-telemetry) is present. could be an ordering/constructor issue. They shared a small repro script.

mike: request from partners: can we coordinate a joint patch release? if they backport a small fix we can remap and re-sign the marketplace image. Otherwise, we pin on our side and publish a compatibility note.

sarah: rebuild ETA: 3 hours for canary images, pushing to canary region ap-southeast-1 first. I'll attach image hashes once done.

jordan: operational rollback snippet for field: 
```bash
# rollback to pinned image
aws ec2 run-instances --image-id ami-0pinned123 --instance-type p4d.24xlarge --count 1
# or in k8s
kubectl set image deployment/inf-svc inf=registry.redwood/pinned-inf:2026-03-18-rocm5.4
```

marketplace-bot: Noted. Will mark marketplace listings for affected SKUs as "pinned - temporary" and surface advisory banner.

ana: PR for partner advisory doc: https://rwd.internal/docs/partnerships/acme-rocm-compat-advisory (draft). Mike, can you drop the joint announcement hold note here once you confirm?

mike: yes. I will coordinate with ACME PM - asking them to confirm whether they want a joint advisory or a partner-specific patch note. Also asking SI teams if they saw similar.

jordan: postmortem checklist for if pinned image still fails: 1) collect kmaps & printk traces 2) instrument kv_cache allocation path 3) enable page poisoning 4) escalate to kernel partner.

sarah: canary image pushed. hashes: sha256:abcd1234... (canary-ap-southeast-1). Running smoke now.

ana: thanks. Mike, add me to the partner comms thread. We'll aim to avoid touching the public announcement until we confirm stability. :thumbsup:

mike: added you. if smoke passes in 6h we'll de-escalate. if not, hotfix window tonight 22:00 PST.

jordan: leaving a note for runtime team: please review rocm kv-cache init ordering with third-party modules. filing an internal ticket: RUNTIME-4582.

sarah: smoke passed on canary (3/3 runs). will start phased rollout to all marketplace regions in 2h.

ana: perfect. Mike - if ACME has a backport, coordinate with release eng to sign new image and update advisory. If not, we'll keep pins and update partner roadmap.

mike: will do. closing loop when I have ACME confirmation. thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
